rules_applied.payment_date_basis: policy 1: second working day of October 2026 (Thu 2026-10-01 is the first, Fri 2026-10-02 the second)

conventions.decision: pay = schedule now; hold = on the run but do not schedule until the reconciler sends a changed dec; exclude = not in the run
conventions.amount_to_pay: gross, in the document's own currency: what the document produces when released. 0.00 for exclude. Only decision=pay lines are payable now (pay_now=true).
conventions.variance_net: invoice net minus PO net, in the PO currency, two decimals, same format as the var slot: positive (no sign) when the invoice is above the PO, negative below. null when there is no PO or nothing is payable.
conventions.approval: REQ = principal approval or decision needed and not yet given; OK = given; NO = declined; NA = not needed
